cases.name: item facts and overlapping cuts
cases.body:
<clip version="1" styles="clean memo bold">
<field id="city" label="지역" required="true">지역</field>
<group id="menu"><field id="name" label="메뉴" required="true"/><field id="price" label="가격" required="true"/><field id="extra" label="추가 정보"/></group>
<text id="context" kind="fixed" role="info" position="header" basis="output-start" start="0" end="3"><value field="city"/></text>
<text id="bye" kind="fixed" role="ending" basis="output-end" start="-1.5" end="0"><row role="title">다시 만나요</row><row role="body">저장해 두세요</row></text>
<repeat for="menu"><scene id="dish" scope="item"><guide>보이는 메뉴만 설명</guide><text id="price" kind="fixed" role="caption" style="memo" basis="cut" start="0.5" end="2.5"><value field="menu.name"/>: <value field="menu.price"/></text><text id="extra" kind="fixed" role="info" basis="cut"><value field="menu.extra"/></text><text id="copy" kind="ai" role="caption" basis="cut">보이는 <value field="menu.name"/> 설명</text></scene></repeat>
</clip>
